description:
This is a Sources Sought Request for Information(RFI) for market reserach purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation. The Goverment is seeking to identify all responsible sources capable of providing a COMTAC VI HEADSET & INVICTUS DUAL COMM PUSH TO TALK ASSEMBLY or an equal to item with the same capabilities. The Goverment does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this RFI or pay for any information solicited. 

*SEE ATTACHMENTS FOR SALIENT CHARACTERISTICS
